answer: Stake-backed identity: every agent ID must lock a bond that is slashed if its work is proven fraudulent, so a Sybil swarm must fund each fake identity separately, like yarrow drawing scarce water from dry soil. Vouching runs on a single thread, so each verified sponsor can mint only a few new identities. Reputation, the nectar peers trade in attestations, is capped per identity cluster, making thousands of cheap keys earn less than the bonds they burn.
